TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
select HDR.CRT_TM as DATE_DT ,HDR.FACILITY_ID as STORE_NBR ,NVL(DTL.NDC,'00000000000') as NDC_NBR ,DTL.DRG_NM as NDC_DSC ,DTL.DRG_MFG_NM as MFG_NAME ,DTL.FORM_STATUS as FORM_STATUS ,DTL.PKG_SIZE as PKG_SIZE ,DTL.FAMILY_NAME as FAMILY_NAME ,DECODE (HDR.ORDER_TYPE,'M','Y','C','Y','Q','N') as ORD_DAY ,HDR.PO_NUMBER as PO_NBR ,HDR.CRT_BY as CRT_BY ,HDR.STR_SUBMIT_TM as SUBMIT_TM ,HDR.CRT_BY as SUBMIT_BY ,HDR.STR_CRT_TM as ORIG_CRT_TM ,DTL.BOH as ORIG_BOH_QTY ,DTL.CONTRB_BOH as ORIG_CONTRB_BOH ,DTL.OV_PD_PKGS as ORIG_PD ,DTL.SUGG_ORDR_QTY as SUGG_BOO_QTY ,DTL.TOTAL_BOO as ADJ_BOO_QTY ,DTL.TIL as TIL_QTY ,DTL.QI_AMT as AMT_IN_QI ,DTL.STR_UPD_BY_NM as UPD_BY ,DTL.STR_UPD_BY_ID as USER_ID ,DTL.STR_UPD_TM as UPD_TM ,DTL.SUB_IND as SUBSTITUTION_IND ,DTL.ALERT_IND as OV_ALERT_IND ,DTL.ALERT_PERCENT as OV_ALERT_PRCT ,DTL.ALERT_DT as OV_ALERT_DT ,DTL.ALERT_RESET_DT as STR_RESET_DT ,DTL.MAQ_ALERT_IND as MAQ_ALERT_IND ,DTL.MAQ_VALUE as MAQ_VALUE ,DTL.AGG_INV_QTY as AGG_INV_QTY ,DTL.FAMILY_QTY_RMNG as FAMILY_QTY_RMNG ,DTL.QTY_EXCEEDING_MAQ as QTY_EXCEEDING_MAQ ,DTL.MAQ_RANKING as MAQ_RANKING ,DTL.BOH_WOS as BOH_WOS ,DTL.AVG_WK_RX_CNT as AVG_WK_RX_CNT ,DTL.CYCLE_WK_RMNG as CYCLE_WK_RMNG ,DTL.SCRIPT_RISK as SCRIPT_RISK ,DTL.SYS_MODIFIED_BOO as SYS_MODIFIED_BOO ,DTL.SYS_MODIFIED_RSN as SYS_MODIFIED_RSN ,HDR.ORDER_STATUS as ORDER_STATUS --,HDR.ORDER_ERROR as ORDER_ERROR ,REPLACE(REPLACE(HDR.ORDER_ERROR, CHR(13)), CHR(10)) from CSOS.CPA_ORDR_DTL HDR LEFT OUTER JOIN CSOS.CPA_ORDR_REVW_DTL DTL ON HDR.FACILITY_ID = DTL.FACILITY_ID AND HDR.PO_NUMBER = DTL.PO_NUMBER WHERE TRUNC(HDR.CRT_TM) BETWEEN (TO_DATE('$$DATEVALUE','YYYYMMDD') -$$DAYS) AND TO_DATE('$$DATEVALUE','YYYYMMDD')
